results.instruction: Listen to the music intro.
Stop driving immediately to prevent further damage to the tire and wheel.
Park the car safely on a firm, level surface away from traffic.
Set up a warning triangle and turn on the hazard lights.
Switch off the ignition and ensure all passengers exit the vehicle safely.
Retrieve the spare wheel and replacement tools from the trunk.
Identify the jack and wrench among the tools.
Use the provided tool to remove the hubcap if the wheel has one.
Use the wrench to loosen the wheel nuts one half to one turn.
Apply extra force to loosen tight nuts if necessary.
Use your foot to help loosen the nuts by hand if needed.
Prepare to jack up the car.
Locate the jacking point on the underside of the vehicle near the wheel.
Consult the owner's manual if you cannot find the jacking point.
Never place any object or body part under the vehicle while jacking.
Jack up the vehicle until the flat tire clears the road.
Avoid touching the disc wheels or brakes as they may be hot.
Lift the spare wheel onto the hub and align the holes.
Replace the wheel nuts and tighten them until firm.
Lower the jack until the spare wheel touches the ground.
Use the wrench to tighten the wheel nuts firmly in sequence.
